rationale: Baseline 2026-09-30: Web Lite HTML about 822 KB; complete CJK fonts 58,863,976 bytes. Allow about 15 percent HTML growth and 10 percent font growth; retain complete fonts and licenses. Stage budgets bound duplicated public resources and standalone dependency growth. Changes require an explained review. Local 6.5.9 stage: app 286,166 bytes, server 127,942,887 bytes; 2 MB shell ceiling and 145 MB server ceiling retain room for runtime variation while detecting large dependencies. Packaged runtime baseline 504,992,730 bytes, ceiling 550 MB (about 9 percent headroom); updater stage baseline 2,284,179 bytes, ceiling 3 MB.
